summary: Adds a hardcoded fallback JWT secret that will be used in any environment where JWT_SECRET is not set, including production.

findings.message: Hardcoded fallback secret 'supersecret123abc' will be used if the environment variable is absent, making token forgery trivial.
findings.suggestion: Remove the fallback and throw an error at startup if JWT_SECRET is not set: if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET) throw new Error('JWT_SECRET must be set');
